items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The director of the American Center, a Mr. John Melton and his wife did everything possible to make our visit enjoyable. He gave us the use of a car...

ctx.x: After the concert, we were all invited to the home of the American Consul. He and his wife were a young couple with two or three children. As we were to take our early plane back to Algiers, we managed to stay drinking and talking at the Consul's home until the time to pick up our luggage at our Hotel, and take a couple of taxis to the airport.

There was another concert the 11th of April in Blida, which is about 35 miles from Algiers. The 12th and 13th we did concerts in Algiers. They were the most successful, because Algiers is so much larger than the other places we played, the publicity was done better because the Hot Club of Algiers, the Cultural Center of the city, and the American one all worked together to present these concerts. The director of the American Center, a Mr. John Melton and his wife did everything possible to make our visit…
The two concerts were very successful with a large attendance, mostly Algerian and a few Europeans. The public was very enthusiastic, and the last concert was broadcasted directly from the theatre.
